name: Growth Pricing & Peers
description: Evaluates the relative pricing of high-growth companies (including pre-profit, high revenue-growth names) by asking: given the quality of this business, what expectations are already embedded in today's stock price? Builds historical valuation data tables (10 years or since IPO) across three dimensions — Revenue & Gross Profit, Earnings, and Cash Flow — from EODHD, SEC EDGAR and yfinance data, followed by a short narrative discussion per dimension. Peer comparison is a planned future phase.
